name: Nail My Interview: Mock Interview
description: Practice job interviews inside your AI assistant: get 5 realistic questions for any job title, answer them, and get honest feedback on each answer.
author: Nail My Interview

tools.name: start_mock_interview
tools.description: Starts a practice mock interview for a job: returns 5 realistic interview questions for the given job title (and company, if given).

role.description: The job title, e.g. "Sales associate" or "Data analyst".

tools.name: get_answer_feedback
tools.description: Gives feedback on one practice interview answer: a verdict (Strong, Good start or Needs work), what worked, the one thing to fix, and a stronger way to start the answer.

role.description: The job the user is practising for.

question.description: The interview question that was asked.

answer.description: The user's answer, word for word.
